summary: WeRide Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, Hong Kong-listed (Stock Code 0800) and Nasdaq-listed autonomous-driving company, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing an announcement of a grant of 17,880,200 restricted share units under its 2026 Share Plan on September 23, 2026, to 160 grantees at nil purchase price. The grant includes 493,434 RSUs each to founder/CEO Dr. Han and co-founder/CTO Dr. Li, plus 16,893,332 to 158 employees. Reference prices were HK$15.63 per Class A share and US$5.92 per ADS. This is a routine equity-compensation disclosure, not a special situation; watch only for resulting dilution and performance-vesting milestones.
